name: Lake Nazferiti
summary: In northern Stranglethorn, river waters gather at Lake Nazferiti. Crocolisks and snapping frenzies hunt beneath its surface, while the Venture Company works along the shores.

sections.title: Heart of the Jungle Waterway
sections.body: The Nazferiti River runs across the southern Eastern Kingdoms and widens into Lake Nazferiti in Stranglethorn. It begins in the northern heights, where it plunges from the Redridge Mountains in waterfalls. Its headwaters may reach as far inland as Deadwind Pass. By the time the river spreads into the lake, its waters are murky. Snapping river frenzies and crocolisks hunt there, making a swim deadly.

sections.title: Venture Company Encroachment
sections.body: The Venture Company has brought heavy operations to Lake Nazferiti's banks. Goblins cut jungle timber and take other resources with saws, drills, and crews that clear the land. Their base pollutes the water. The work brings them into constant clashes with local wildlife and hunters traveling through the vale.

faq.q: Where does Lake Nazferiti get its water?
aliases: where does lake nazferiti come from
faq.answer: Lake Nazferiti is fed by the Nazferiti River, which begins high in the northern mountains. A waterfall from the Redridge Mountains marks its confirmed source, though the headwaters may reach as far inland as Deadwind Pass.

faq.q: Who controls the shores of Lake Nazferiti?
faq.answer: The Venture Company occupies a major base along Lake Nazferiti's shores. Goblins strip the jungle for wood and minerals, with armed overseers and machinery along the water's edge.

faq.q: Is it safe to swim in Lake Nazferiti?
faq.answer: Swimming in Lake Nazferiti is dangerous. Aggressive river frenzies and lurking crocolisks attack those who venture beyond the shallows.
Lake Nazferiti lies in northern Stranglethorn Vale, just south of the Duskwood border and west of the Zul'Gurub ruins, along the main river highway.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can find game along Lake Nazferiti's shores and in its depths. Aggressive river beasts and crocolisks prowl the reeds.
As a night elf, you can see the damage the Venture Company has done along Lake Nazferiti. Goblin greed scars the land.
